review_note: Official order record identifies the emergency transportation waiver issued in preparation for Hurricane Sandy
Official order record identifies Hurricane Irene and its anticipated wind and flooding impacts

Governor's release 'Governor Declares State of Emergency', January 14, 2004, in the State Library's 2004 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases. The proclamation text cites arctic cold temperatures and dangerous wind chills.

Governor's release 'Governor Guarantees Heating Oil Deliveries', January 26, 2005 (2005 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases): a procedural proclamation signed that day for arctic cold and dangerous wind chills.

The Governor's February 15, 2005 request for federal snow assistance (2005 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases) says: 'On Friday, February 11, I declared that a State of Emergency existed in the State of Maine, in response to the widespread power outages.'
Governor's release 'Governor Declares Emergency to Restore Power', January 19, 2006 (2006 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases). The proclamation text cites a severe wind storm.
The Governor's May 2006 request for a federal declaration (2006 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases) says a State of Emergency was declared in York County as of 2:30 pm on May 14, 2006.

Governor's release 'Governor Baldacci Declares Emergency to Restore Power', October 28, 2006 (2006 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases). The proclamation text cites a severe wind storm, with gusts up to 70 miles an hour.

Governor's release 'Governor Guarantees Heating Oil Deliveries', February 13, 2007 (2007 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases). The proclamation text cites an expected major winter storm, arctic cold and dangerous wind chills.

Governor's release 'Governor Baldacci Signs Emergency Declaration and Advises Caution', April 5, 2007 (2007 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases). The declaration text cites a severe winter storm.

The Governor's April 2007 storm releases (2007 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases) say the State of Emergency went into effect late Sunday night, April 15, 2007; the April 23 release lifting it says the Governor signed it for the Patriots' Day Storm.
Governor's release 'Governor Declares Emergency to Help Restore Power', February 13, 2008 (2008 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases): signed around 8 p.m. that day after the winter storm.
Governor's release 'Governor Declares Emergency to Help Restore Power', February 23, 2009 (2009 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases): issued at 9 a.m. that day after the winter storm.

Governor's release 'Governor Declares Emergency to Help Restore Power', July 22, 2010 (2010 archive of Governor Baldacci's press releases): ordered at 2:30 p.m. after the previous night's severe thunderstorms.
